note: Provincial park on the south shore of Buffalo Lake, leased to and run by the Summer Village of Rochon Sands. Most sites are treed; the more open row on the north edge (sites 8-11, 13, 16, 18, 20, 22 and 24) looks out over the lake. Campground water is non-potable: a coin-and-card drinking-water bucket fill is on Hwy 835 at the village boundary, and the park office has small amounts. Boat launch, fish-cleaning station, playground and beach. --Claude
